pi4 generates; pi3 holds the canned map and train→delete loop; pi2 does health and optional mirror. No weak-board chat generate.

No. Serve from the canned map if present; otherwise forward to pi4. pi3 must not load chat weights for the user.

Fail closed with a named error for the miss. Keep serving cache hits. Do not demote generation to pi2 or pi3.

What is working memory vs the dataset?
Working memory is pi4's weights/activations/KV for the current decode. The dataset is the persistent canned input→answer map on pi3.

Log misses into a bounded queue on pi3, prepare artifacts, train/update the map or adapters, run the eval gate, promote if green, then delete raw shards.

Why not use a CNN for chat?
Open-ended chat needs long-range token modeling; we use a transformer decoder on pi4. CNNs fit later sensor/vision paths, not chat decode.

Canned hits should feel instant (sub-second local). Misses pay decode cost on pi4 once, then feed the queue so repeats can become hits.

Miss exchanges and flaw signals — bounded, not an unbounded chat archive. After successful update, delete the raw shards.

Normalize/match the input on pi3 (or pi2 mirror), read the stored answer, return it. No embedding table, attention, logits, or sampler on the hot path.

On pi4 only: tokenize → embed → transformer blocks → logits → sample → stream tokens; then enqueue the exchange for later adaptation.
